conventions.physics: isolated MAPF, no warehouse collisions added
conventions.moves: cardinal or wait; vertex and opposite-edge conflicts forbidden
conventions.goals: absorbing on first visit, then persistent; distinct starts and goals within each set
conventions.objective: sum first-arrival ticks; all waits before arrival included
conventions.guarantees: CBS/oracle SOLVED optimal only within stated horizon and absorbing-goal model; budget stop unknown
conventions.timing: full_method_seconds includes input validation, complete search and independent plan checking; setup/BFS separate
conventions.nodes: all expanded low-level, CBS high-level and joint states combined
conventions.conditioning: cost means include solved runs only; compare paired cases, not marginal means with differing completion
